overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice of its April 14 meeting, but the later remedial meeting cured it so no further relief was ordered; the professional-competence allegation was rejected.

allegations.summary: Alleged failure to post notice for an April 14 executive session meeting held to discuss complaints against a former town commissioner.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Board's April 14 meeting was not posted to the Town's website

allegations.summary: Alleged that the board improperly discussed a former commissioner's professional competence in an April 14 executive session.
allegations.key_passage: The Board discussed the allegations, rather than Mr. Noble's professional competence.
